title: Env-file guard stops refusing heredoc text that only writes a file
why: Incident, Nov 1 23:41 CST: main's env-file guard refused triage 5's Bash command that only wrote a roadmap JSON note, because the note text named an env folder inside a python heredoc string. No env file was read or written. Under rule roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes this real incident turns note env-file-rule-false-alarms into a debt.
note: The lane writes the debt record in docs/debts with this incident, pointing at decision env-file-stays-unread, and changes the guard's verdict for env text inside a heredoc body that only writes a file (env_heredoc_refusal in the guard's env module), red first on this command's form. A guard verdict change, so a reviewer checks the net safety value. Not part of PRs #1046 or #1057. Found by lane refusal-uncited-rewrites. Ready. Port: yes.
